description:
“Dheere Dheere Pyar Ko Badhana Hai” is a timeless romantic Hindi song sung beautifully by Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik, known for their soulful and melodious voices that defined 90s Bollywood music. The song captures the gentle progression of love—how feelings gradually deepen between two people.

🎬 Song Details
Title: Dheere Dheere Pyar Ko Badhana Hai
Singers: Kumar Sanu & Alka Yagnik
Music: Nadeem-Shravan

🎭 Cast & Crew
Cast: Ajay Devgn, Madhoo, Aruna Irani, Jagdeep, Amrish Puri
Director: Kuku Kohli
Producer: Dinesh Patel
